title: Kerr bilocal geodesic operator cross-formulation qualification
claim_ceiling: A future passing result qualifies finite-dimensional Kerr geodesic-deviation and optical-transfer calculations only. It does not qualify finite-frequency wave optics, plasma transfer, detector predictions, or a new Lorentzian theorem.

references.name: Self-lensing of gravitational waves from binary extreme-mass-ratio inspirals: Extended caustics and paired flashes
references.role: Point-to-point Kerr lens map, BGO-derived Jacobi map, image-resolved magnification and arrival times.

references.name: Observational signatures of Kerr black hole lensing
references.role: Independent Schwarzschild and Mathematica/NDSolve geodesic checks and image/extended-source observables.

references.name: Geometric optics in general relativity using bilocal operators
references.kind: reference cited by the 2026 BGO application
references.role: Foundational BGO formalism; replace placeholder with the exact pinned bibliographic record before external-comparison execution.

conventions.geodesic_deviation: D xi/dlambda = ell; D ell/dlambda = -T xi
conventions.optical_tidal_operator: T^mu_nu = R^mu_(alpha nu beta) k^alpha k^beta
conventions.endpoint_comparison: Only compare after explicit event, chart, tetrad, affine normalization and source-surface matching.

operator.canonical_comparison: Transform the canonical (delta x, delta p) fundamental matrix into covariant (xi,ell) at both endpoints, including metric and metric-derivative terms. Direct elementwise 8x8 comparison is forbidden.
operator.screen_reduction: Seed with observer angular variations, project into the parallel Sachs screen, and apply the fixed-source-event correction. Emit fixed-affine and fixed-source maps separately.

benchmark_ladder.name: Minkowski analytic transfer
acceptance: all four blocks match closed form

proposed_targets.refinement: N, 2N, 4N; include independent nearby-ray perturbation-size refinement
proposed_targets.caustic_localization: conditioning-aware interval from step, angular and source-surface refinement; no determinant-clamping

execution_gates: Do not implement caustic classification before BGO-0 through BGO-4 pass.
Do not claim a physical caustic until BGO-5 and BGO-6 pass at matched endpoints and independent refinement.
Do not claim external SOTA parity until BGO-7 reproduces pinned published cases.
Do not compare raw throughput outside matched qualified-observable bins.
